lead.question: 作者为何说姑妈去世反倒是好事？她苦寻的理想仆人贝西为何最终被解雇？
lead.warmup: 《理想的仆人》是一篇带讽刺意味的回忆散文。作者以幽默而克制的笔调，回忆姑妈哈丽特如何执着寻找一位十全十美的佣人，最终却被最信任的贝西伤透了心。文中语言点密集：虚拟语气、让步从句、so...that 结果状语从句、not only 倒装，以及 servant、employer、domestic staff、ideal 等家政词汇，值得反复诵读体会。
goals: 掌握 servant、employer、domestic staff、ideal 等与雇佣、家政相关的核心词汇及搭配。
学会 if + 过去式(were)...would do 的虚拟语气，谈论与现在事实相反的假设。
辨析并运用让步从句(though / although / even though / no matter how)与 so...that 结果状语从句。
能读懂并复述贝西从“理想仆人”到被当场解雇的讽刺故事，体会作者的幽默语调。
lead.summary: 姑妈哈丽特生活在佣人包办家务的悠闲年代。她有一所大而无当的乡间宅邸“山墙庄园”，总把它收拾得一尘不染，并把来来去去的佣人称作“流动人口”。她当时推行开明政策，不让家仆每天工作超过八小时，却极难伺候，一生都在寻找“理想的仆人”。贝西干得最出色，三年后当上大管家，却因酗酒在客人面前把布丁摔飞，当场遭解雇；事后姑妈还在她衣柜里找到一堆从酒窖偷来的空酒瓶。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：让步连接词 although / though 与 but 不能连用；difficult to please 用主动形式表被动含义，不能说 difficult to be pleased。

questions.q: It is a good thing my aunt Harriet died years ago. If she were alive today she would not be able to air her views on her favourite topic of conversation: domestic servants. Aunt Harriet lived in that
questions.zh: 幸好我的姑妈哈丽特多年前就去世了；如果她活到今天，她就不能就她最爱的话题——佣人——发表意见了。哈丽特生活的正是那样的……
questions.a: The sentence is completed as '...that leisurely age when servants were employed to do housework.' Aunt Harriet belonged to a time when paid servants did all the housework, so she would be quite out of place today.
questions.aZh: 补全为“……那个悠闲的年代，家务事都由雇来的佣人代劳”。也就是说，哈丽特属于一个由雇来的佣人包办家务的年代，若活在今天她必然格格不入。
questions.hint: 出处：听力句后紧跟的课文首句 servants were employed to do housework，并结合首段的虚拟语气判断。

questions.q: Who was Bessie, and what position did she reach in Aunt Harriet's household?
questions.zh: 贝西是谁？她在哈丽特家做到了什么职位？
questions.a: Bessie worked for Aunt Harriet for three years, and during that time she so gained my aunt's confidence that she was put in charge of the domestic staff. In addition to all her other qualifications, she was an expert cook.
questions.aZh: 贝西为哈丽特姑妈工作了三年，其间深得姑妈信任，被委以管理全体家仆的重任；除其他本领外，她还是一位烹饪高手。
questions.hint: 出处：Bessie worked for Aunt Harriet for three years... 及 she was put in charge of the domestic staff。

questions.q: What happened when Aunt Harriet returned unexpectedly with a party of guests?
questions.zh: 哈丽特突然带着一批客人回来时发生了什么？
questions.a: The meal was well below the usual standard, and Bessie seemed unable to walk steadily: she bumped into the furniture and kept mumbling about the guests. With the last course she tripped on the carpet and the huge pudding went flying through the air, narrowly missed my aunt and crashed on the dining table.
questions.aZh: 饭菜远不如平时，贝西走路东倒西歪，撞到家具，还不停嘟囔着议论客人。端最后一道菜时她在地毯上绊倒，一大盘布丁飞了出去，擦着姑妈身边飞过，狠狠砸在餐桌上。
questions.hint: 出处：After being absent from the Gables for a week... 所引出的一整段。

questions.q: What did Aunt Harriet discover after Bessie's departure, and why was it damning?
questions.zh: 贝西走后姑妈发现了什么？为什么这足以说明问题？
questions.a: She discovered piles of empty wine bottles of all shapes and sizes neatly stacked in what had once been Bessie's wardrobe; they had mysteriously found their way there from the wine cellar, which proved that Bessie had been drinking heavily all along.
questions.aZh: 她发现贝西以前用过的衣柜里整整齐齐地堆着各种形状、大小不一的空酒瓶；这些瓶子神不知鬼不觉地从酒窖来到了这里，足见贝西其实一直嗜酒。
questions.hint: 出处：课文最后两句 piles of empty wine bottles...from the wine cellar。

questions.q: Why does the writer call the servants 'the shifting population', and what does the ending suggest about the 'ideal servant'?
questions.zh: 作者为何把仆人称作“流动人口”？故事结尾对“理想仆人”说明了什么？
questions.a: They came and went with such frequency that the writer never even got a chance to learn their names, which is why Aunt Harriet called them 'the shifting population'. The ending is ironic: the seemingly perfect Bessie, whom the household trusted, had secretly been drinking, so Aunt Harriet's lifelong search for the ideal servant ended in disillusionment — the perfect servant exists only in the imagination.
questions.aZh: 他们来去太频繁，作者甚至无暇记住他们的名字，所以姑妈称他们为“流动人口”。结尾颇具讽刺意味：看似完美、深得全家信任的贝西其实一直偷偷酗酒，姑妈一生寻找理想仆人的努力最终以失望告终——完美仆人只存在于想象之中。
questions.hint: 提示：结合“the shifting population”的解释与结尾的反讽，谈理想仆人的虚妄。

exercises.q: 汉译英：她虽然极难伺候，却从不允许家里的佣人每天工作超过八小时。
exercises.a: Though she was extremely difficult to please, she never allowed her domestic staff to work more than eight hours a day.
exercises.note: 让步从句 + allow sb to do。

exercises.q: 汉译英（用虚拟语气）：如果她活到今天，她就不能就她最爱的话题——佣人——发表意见了。
exercises.a: If she were alive today, she would not be able to air her views on her favourite topic of conversation: domestic servants.
exercises.note: if + were...would not be able to。

exercises.q: 用定语从句把两句合并：She presided over an invisible army of servants. They continuously scrubbed, cleaned and polished.
exercises.a: She presided over an invisible army of servants that continuously scrubbed, cleaned and polished.
exercises.note: that 引导定语从句修饰 servants。

exercises.q: 填空（让步从句）：No matter ___ many guests were present, the great house was always immaculate.
exercises.note: no matter how + 形容词/副词。

exercises.q: 改错：Although it was far too big for her needs, but she persisted in living there.
exercises.a: Although it was far too big for her needs, she persisted in living there.（删去 but）
exercises.note: although 不与 but 连用。

exercises.q: 句型转换（结果状语从句）：She gained my aunt's confidence. As a result, she was put in charge of the domestic staff.
exercises.a: She so gained my aunt's confidence that she was put in charge of the domestic staff.
exercises.note: so + 副词 + that 引导结果从句。

exercises.q: 选词填空（servant / employer / staff / ideal）：Aunt Harriet was a generous ___ who treated her domestic ___ well, yet she never stopped searching for the ___ servant.

quiz.q: 哈丽特姑妈那幢巨大杂乱的乡间宅邸叫什么名字？
quiz.note: 课文：a huge, rambling country house called 'The Gables'。

quiz.q: 姑妈把那些来去匆匆的佣人称作什么？
quiz.note: she always referred to them as 'the shifting population'。

quiz.q: 贝西为哈丽特姑妈一共工作了多少年？
quiz.note: Bessie worked for Aunt Harriet for three years。

quiz.q: 晚宴上贝西失态的真正原因是什么？
quiz.note: She came to the conclusion that Bessie was drunk。

quiz.q: 贝西离开后，姑妈在她的衣柜里发现了什么？
quiz.note: 空酒瓶自酒窖神秘地来到衣柜。

quiz.q: 姑妈对待佣人的政策在当时被认为是怎样的？
quiz.note: 课文评其 an enlightened policy。
